name: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition
description: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game in the Neverwinter Nights series.

eax.problem: This is the Enhanced Edition, not the classic Neverwinter Nights, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic Neverwinter Nights, it's a separate GOG purchase, 'Neverwinter Nights Diamond', and that one has EAX.
